description.summary: Visual representation of Figure 1: The pipeline for MultiDocFusion. The figure illustrates the step-by-step process for handling a long industrial document. (a) DP extracts layout structures; (b) OCR recognizes and annotates text; (c) DSHP-LLM constructs a hierarchical tree from identified section headers and general nodes; (d) DFS-based Grouping constructs coherent hierarchical chunks for retrieval tasks. The color-coded blocks represent document elements: yellow for Root and Title, red for Section Headers, and green for general nodes (tables, figures, and text blocks). on page 3.
description.data_flow: Query is routed to dense and sparse retrievers, fused via RRF, and passed to LLM.
